incident: Webhook duplicate delivery after retry change
symptoms: merchant systems received duplicate payment webhooks
duplicates began after retry configuration change
recent_changes: See root-cause context; synthetic historical incident.
root_cause: Webhook retry policy was changed without preserving idempotency keys across retries.
resolution: A retry configuration change dropped idempotency keys, allowing duplicate webhook delivery. Restoring the key propagation fixed duplicates.
postmortem: Restarting workers did not change event identity.
Longer timeout did not address duplicate semantics.
